content:
alex.chen: kicking off the rollout checkin for `orca-13b-v2` in the model catalog. change window midnight-03:00 UTC. canaries start at 3% then 20% if green.

sana.khan: noted. SLA guardband at 250ms p95; rollback if >15% error rate or latency spike >2x baseline for 10m.

ivan.petrov: can we ensure fallback ordering has quantized variant ahead of legacy 13b to save cost?

lisa_m: yes — proposed fallback chain is: `orca-13b-v2-quant` -> `orca-13b-v1` -> `small-440m`. quant first to keep perf.

alex.chen: deploybot, schedule canary job in eu-west-1 at 00:30 UTC and us-central1 at 01:00 UTC.

deploybot: @alex.chen scheduled: `catalog.enable(orca-13b-v2)` canary 3% eu-west-1 @ 1765990200, staged 20% us-central1 @ 1765992000. Logs will stream to #eng-releases. :rocket:

tim.garcia: ops note — autoscaler will be pinned to reserved pool during canary to avoid noisy neighbours. remember to unpin before ramp to 100%.

ivan.petrov: adding pin list now. code snippet:```json
{"models_to_pin": ["orca-13b-v2", "orca-13b-v2-quant"], "duration":"2h", "drain_before_switch": true}
```

sana.khan: safety gates checklist: 1) perf within guardband 2) embeddings sanity test 3) regen test on 100 prompt set 4) no increase in upstream error.

alex.chen: who is owning rollback decision call if we see regression? nominate ops-oncall + model-rt lead.

lisa_m: i'll be model-rt lead for this window. ops-oncall is @ivan.petrov.

tim.garcia: suggested rollback threshold: revert to `orca-13b-v1` if quality eval delta > 3% or user-visible instr failures > 1% over baseline for 15m.

ivan.petrov: adding a throttling ramp: 3% -> 10% after 30m -> 20% after 1h -> hold 1h -> decide. manual handoff at 20% -> full.

alex.chen: confirm observability hooks: token-level latency, per-route error, token-cost meter, prefix cache hit rate.

sana.khan: checks wired up. alert thresholds: token_latency_p95 > 250ms, error_rate > 3% (warn) > 8% (critical).

deploybot: preflight passed: dependency checks ok, model artifacts checksum matched, quant variant validated.

lisa_m: one more: fallback ordering should include TTL for quant variant of 24h then evict to reduce memory churn. anyone object?

tim.garcia: sounds fine. make TTL configurable in runtime — we'll need to tune if eviction causes cold-start latency.

alex.chen: final runbook excerpt:```text
00:30 UTC - enable canary eu-west-1 (3%)
00:45 UTC - monitor 15m metrics
01:00 UTC - ramp eu-west to 10% if green
01:00 UTC - enable canary us-central1 (3%)
01:30 UTC - ramp across both to 20% if green
02:30 UTC - decision point: proceed to 100% or rollback
Rollback triggers: sustained error >8% for 10m, latency >2x baseline for 15m, eval quality drop >3%.
```

ivan.petrov: i'll be on the call at 02:20 UTC for final decision.

sana.khan: tagging incident responders onstandby. :shield:

alex.chen: ok pulling the trigger on the preflight checklist. if anything weird, react here and ping pager.

deploybot: starting canary rollout in eu-west-1 now. job id 654321. stream: https://deploy.redwood/654321

lisa_m: watching metrics. small perf blip at +10% token p95 at minute 4 but back to baseline at minute 7. continuing.

tim.garcia: memory utilization stable. cache hit 72%.

ivan.petrov: no alerts so far. keeping pins for 2h.

sana.khan: running regen eval on golden prompts now — first batch looks fine.

alex.chen: if we pass the 1h hold point let's plan to unpin models before full ramp. noted.
